basic_info.description: Step into elegance with this exceptional Alamo Square Victorian! Upon entering this light filled flat, you’ll immediately notice the perfect balance between modern luxury and victorian era charm. Soaring ceilings, a huge bay window and many period details make this the quintessential San Francisco home. Flat is the top floor of a lovingly maintained two unit building and has been beautifully updated with a new tiled shower and chic lighting fixtures. Updated eat in kitchen has quartz countertops, tile backsplash and stainless steel appliances. Large, private laundry room. Enjoy peaceful serenity in the beautifully landscaped, shared backyard, with paver patio, artificial turf lawn and raised garden beds - a perfect place to BBQ, entertain and relax! Deeded one car parking in the garage and shared parking space in the driveway. Located in the heart of San Francisco, between NOPA, Western Addition, Lower Pacific Heights, Hayes Valley, Haight-Ashbury and only two blocks from Alamo Square - home of the iconic painted ladies. With a walk score of 96, there are many great spots a short walk away including The Mill, Che Fico, The Independent, Brenda's Meat & Three, Nopa, and Bi-Rite Market. Both units in the building are available. 1529A Golden Gate Ave. is waiting to welcome you home!
